note: Items that could not be confirmed, that conflict with another source, or that need a human decision. None of them blocks the publication of this desk. Each item links to the source it came from.

flags.title: Literal band gate makes the high-confidence window very narrow
flags.detail: The brief asks for picks with more than 70% probability AND fair prices between -250 and +10000. A 70% favourite is priced about -233, so the literal band admits only probabilities from 70.0% to about 71.4%. This desk applies both conditions literally. Please confirm the intended reading.

flags.title: Scope: 'Gaelic Sports' and 'Rugby League' interpretation
flags.detail: OLBG lists Gaelic football and hurling separately. This desk treats 'Gaelic Sports' as both, which is why the Shinty-Hurling International row appears. Rugby League is treated as the rugby league competition on nrl.com (Rugby League World Cup 2026), which is the only league-level fixture source read in this session.
